notes.title: Elevating Mars
notes.content:
Mars - Building ElevatorsDear distinguished Orbiteers!


We're excited to present you the third orbit you can explore in Orbiteers: Mars!



Mars is the perfect location for our very first Space Elevator. With only about a third of Earths gravity, building a functional elevator will be easy. The basic framework is already in place, but it still needs something special to reach its full potential.


The New Core
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/f7fba103bb47a65a220e07dfb2c23583a8732f76.png"]

The basic infrastructure is already there, but do you see all that empty space? 

That's where our newest invention comes in: Replacer Modules™ (Patent Pending)


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/63b2925df1c944286b6c8947ce1a509cf438cd67.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/b4116b9ce39f3cb8e0bc4e79c24b47d582d4ccf1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/f3ffba38609c8280bf71aab1e7227671747aea7b.png"][/carousel]


Each Replacer Module™ offers different bonuses that speed up the development of the Martian orbit. Will you install luxurious hotels for daring tourists, auxiliary power units for power efficiency, or large warehouses to fuel industry? You decide how the space elevator develops!


Base in a Box
Mission Control is shaking things up! You start the second Martian level with many different modules and have to show your strategic prowess by reaching a sky-high score before new offers unlock. Can you reach Mission Control's ambitious expectations in this brand-new mode?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/cd395a33758b0b1b740654cb90af1358786850c1.png"]


Protecting Against Solar Winds
Our latest measurements have shown that solar activity has been steadily rising. To make sure our astronauts won't get fried we need to protect the station from solar winds.

For this purpose, Mission Control has introduced a new module: The Solar Wind Repeller.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/1e7edac7e8f694eaa5b42f18011395115957c0e4.gif"]



It creates a perimeter around itself in which the station is effectively shielded from the sun's ionizing radiation. For safety, modules must be placed entirely within this perimeter. Recent data from satellites appears to show that we might have to do this for some stations in Earth's orbit too...



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/b15e3dec2ac91412079b0b243eac8db75860f034.png"]


How will you shape Mars’ first space elevator? Find out when Orbiteers releases in Q4 2025!
Wishlist now!



Thank you for your support,

The Orbiteers Developers

notes.title: Exploring the Moon
notes.content:
The Moon - Earth's companionHey Orbiteers!


Today we want to show you the second level of Orbiteers: The Moon!



The Moon's orbit is home to the remains of the first failed space station. The old station broke apart into several clusters and Mission Control wants us Orbiteers to reintegrate these into a brand new station. This introduces a new mechanic unique to the moon:


Station Reclamation
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/89f27f5b7d4eafde9b807f5a7ec7fef78801b97c.png"]

This is just one of the many abandoned clusters that can be found floating around in Lunar orbit. Each cluster has a variety of useful modules that can be recaptured by a skilled Orbiteer.

It is unknown if they are dangerous, however. They must remain isolated for the crew's safety. This is where the Moon's special module comes into play: The Isolation Bridge.



Isolation Bridge - The Moon's special module

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/e1762924e0dccb2b74914aaad3dac2f005adb87d.gif"]



The isolation bridge connects our brand new station to the remains of the old station. They ensure that any danger that may be present can't spread and harm our crew.



Reclaiming a cluster

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/d270d35b054ab4b612ba62a4cbfa228a5d8d6593.gif"]

Reclaiming a cluster will instantly activate all modules in the cluster and grant you a massive influx of points. The reclaimed modules will also count towards your mission progress.


The moon levels and all other levels will be available once Orbiteers releases in Q4 2025!
Wishlist now!



Thank you for your support,

The Orbiteers Developers

notes.title: Demo Release & Exploring Earth
notes.content:
Earth - A deep dive into your first orbitHello everyone!


The demo of Orbiteers is now live! You can download it on the Orbiteers store page and play all three Earth levels for free. 

We'd love to hear your thoughts on either Discord or the Steam forums. Your feedback helps us improve the game before launch!

In the rest of this blog post, we'll look at Orbiteers' first level and highlight it's unique mechanics.




Earth - The home of all humanity
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/4662851f99cca0021df75a0ea4bb61a100855575.png"]

The view from orbit is just amazing right? Everyone thats ever lived was born there, but who knows how long that will hold true...



Your first stop in conquering our solar system is our home planet: Earth! The big blue marble should be home to a variety of powerful stations producing L.U.N.A. Alloy, but what exactly is this alloy?




L.U.N.A. Alloy
Recently, L.U.N.A. invented a revolutionary new quantum-metal alloy, and decided to call it after herself. This alloy allows the construction of many different modules and cutting-edge machines that will help all Orbiteers on their mission of conquering the solar system.



Due to it's intricate nature, producing it on earth is nearly impossible. As such L.U.N.A. suggested the construction of multiple large scale orbital factories to meet the new demand. Shipments of material will be handled by the already-built station core, your job will be the construction of a station, able to support multiple advanced L.U.N.A. Alloy factories.




Special modules
For every orbit a special module has been designed by Mission Control. They will be crucial for the success of the mission. Special modules always require L.U.N.A. Alloy to construct.

L.U.N.A. Alloy Factory - Earth's special module

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561730/2364b8802326cdd8a755126614724a5c4a366116.gif"]




Alternate Levels
On top of the regular levels, every orbit comes with two bonus levels that serve as an alternate version with higher difficulty. Not only are they more challenging, but they also contain completely different mission objectives. The demo contains the levels A-1, A-2 and A-3.




The Earth levels are playable for free right now!Download the demo today!


Thank you for your support,

The Orbiteers Developers

notes.title: Announcing Orbiteers!
notes.content:
Welcome to Orbiteers!
We're excited to announce our new game set in various orbits across the solar system!

Design efficient space stations across the solar system in this minimalist puzzle-builder. Solve unique challenges with help from your assistant L.U.N.A., optimize your builds, maximize your score, and lead humanity’s journey beyond Earth! 

Will you accept the challenge?

[previewyoutube=KXWLQXX2LZM;full][/previewyoutube]

Orbits

Earth
L.U.N.A. has invented a revolutionary new material, and the ideal place to produce it is the vacuum of space. Many ingredients need to be shipped from Earth, making its orbit the best place to set up the factory.


Moon
The Moon's orbit is home to the remains of the first failed space station. Reclaiming the old station could yield invaluable data on structural decay in orbit.


Mars
The red planet is humanity’s best hope for a second home. The construction of a space elevator will reduce transport costs and support colonization efforts.


Saturn
Saturn’s rings are a goldmine – literally. Cutting-edge tech enables us to harvest the vast quantities of metal drifting in orbit, essential for humanity’s ambitions.


Neptune
The edge of the solar system holds the key to interstellar travel. Neptune’s composition is perfect for automated fuel production – if the station can withstand the extreme conditions.


In the coming months, we'll explore each planet and their unique gameplay in detail.

Interested? Add our game to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2979290

Thank you for your support,
The Orbiteers Developers
